svg.text: Voya | D0 Data-Flow Diagram B: Plan a Trip
Goal: Voya helps budget-conscious travelers commit to a trip with confidence by turning real travelers' day-by-day
itineraries and reported spending into transparent, month-specific cost breakdowns they can remix into their own plans.
C7 Data Store: itineraries, cost_items, climate normals, flags
Timing budget (AC-01.1): breakdown on screen in <= 3 s =
render 0.3 + network 0.5 + C2 0.2 + C4 query and aggregate 1.5
+ 0.5 slack. Month search: same 3 s budget (team assumption).
Reliability rule (UC-01): n >= 3 reliable; n = 1-2 'limited data';
n = 0 'no data yet' plus nearest month. Flagging requires sign-in.
Process step done by a component we build (C#)
Data in motion: text = the data and its form
